request.text: Compose original music for Crimson Thread Pilgrimage, a dark fairytale underground action-adventure. Natural acoustic instruments, expressive phrasing, clear voicing, transparent mix with space for gameplay sound effects. No imitation of existing music or named artists, no chiptune, EDM drops, trailer braams or mastering distortion. Shared original Silent Toll motif: D4 down to A3 then up to B-flat3, then a rest; leave it unresolved except in endings A and C. Crimson Thread countertheme: D4 leap to B-flat4, then A4 G4 F4 E4, in plucked timbres. A single short descending warm bell-and-harp arrival gesture B5-A5-D5 then one delicate D6 bell. Soft falling mechanical motion, compact clean game jingle, no introduction and no extra repeat. Strictly instrumental; NO vocals, humming, choir, lyrics, speech or narration. This is a complete one-shot cue: finish deliberately and let the last resonance decay within the duration.
